description: This PHP source file defines the 'I18NError' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Entity' namespace. It models entities for internationalization error types, with constants representing different error conditions and properties for 'name' and 'message' with associated getter and setter methods. The class is mapped to the 'ohrm_i18n_error' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations.
